title: Which sold-stock cases need more context before a URL decision
body:
Work through the five fictional stock records and review the reasons attached to each case. Which missing facts would change your decision? Use anonymised or synthetic examples, with current official documentation for technical claims. [SEO for Car Dealerships](https://seoforcardealerships.co.uk/) maintains this project. This thread is for review criteria, not automatic redirect requests or ranking promises.

Start with the [README](https://github.com/SEO-For-Car-Dealerships/sold-stock-decision-tool#readme), then run the documented example locally.
